items.title: UPS Has Frozen Its Dividend at $1.64. Its 6% Yield Raises Questions
items.summary: UPS stopped raising its payout while buybacks vanished and debt climbed. Behind the CEO's reassurance sits a thin cash cushion, a rival with a stronger balance sheet, and one number in 2027 that could decide everything.

items.title: The 5 Best Stocks in Bill Gates’s Portfolio
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Gates Foundation Trust’s latest 13F shows it held Caterpillar, FedEx, Ecolab, Deere and Canadian National Railway without change last quarter, and together they make up more than half of its US stocks. They’re its five positions of 2% or more where analysts’ average price targets sit furthest above today’s prices, from 41% for Caterpillar to 6% for Canadian National.

items.title: FedEx Stock And Other Fuel Cost Winners If Oil Prices Stay Low
